text:
**B**

Response B is the clear winner, mainly because it is far more concise. That conciseness is the core purpose of a summary for a busy manager under a 120-word limit.

- **Word count:** Neither response strictly meets the limit. B comes in at roughly 140 words, slightly over. A runs to roughly 210 words, far over.
- **Padding in A:** A opens with an intro paragraph ("This section sets out the changes… The key points are summarised below…") that says nothing new. Its "Why" section also adds the redundant "The change responds to two main drivers."
- **Completeness:** B covers more of the substance despite being shorter. It keeps:
  - that existing home equipment is retained;
  - that lockers will be provided;
  - the contact point for questions (managers first, then the intranet Q&A).

  A omits all three.
- **Accuracy:** B correctly says team leaders set the common day. A's phrasing ("each team will have a common day on which all members are in the office together") is vaguer and slightly overstates the requirement.
